snippet.title: DEVILISH HAIRDRESSER 😈✂️ The flash game we forgot 🥲 (Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Devilish Hairdresser - Full Gameplay 🎮 
 
In this video, I play one of the most popular flash games from the "GirlsGoGames" website that many people used to play back in the day, originally released in 2009. I want you to dive into nostalgia with me because I also loved this game in my childhood, and I recorded this video for us to have a fun time together ^^ 

Tysm for watching! And sry for the poor video and editing quality ❤️👉👈
